title: Miso chicken tray with sprouts
summary: Miso chicken tray with sprouts is a british dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and Brussels sprouts, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Miso chicken tray with sprouts into even pieces and toss Brussels sprouts with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of Brussels sprouts while you season skinless chicken breast fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle skinless chicken breast fillets and new potatoes among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Miso chicken tray with sprouts before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Miso chicken tray with sprouts into warm bowls with the juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
